notes.title: Update 10 (Controls Update)
notes.content:
Another small update for ya! 

We've decided to switch weapon interactions (grabbing clips, pulling slides, grabbing ammo from your belt) from the [b]grip button[/b] to the [b]trigger[/b]. This should fix some common grabbing-the-wrong-thing issues. If you'd like to keep the old controls, this can be reverted in the new "Controls" menu.

(0.2.4) Changes:
-Fixed two-handed weapons turning upside down when gripped with left
-Changed grabbing controls (Weapon interactions now use trigger! Can be reverted in settings)
-Added Left-Handed Mode
-Improved sound design for weapon/attachment handling
-Added “Bass Boost” option in Audio Menu (for small speakers, particularly the Vive)
-Various minor fixes

We're also doing devlogs! Feel free to check out the latest one [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YKjmbjPmPh4&t=227s]here[/url].

Cheers!

notes.title: Unreal Engine 5 Update
notes.content:
Today is a big day for Heartshot as we’ve fully transitioned our project from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5! This change should help improve some common wobbly-screen issues. If you’re still experiencing weird stutters, try installing the latest drivers for your GPU or adjust some settings in the new graphics menu. Controller offsets may need to be readjusted in the new version.

(0.2.0) Changes;
-Migrated to Unreal Engine 5!
-screen stuttering improved
-major performance improvements
-fully switched to OpenXR
-various holster fixes
-fixed disabled hands problem
-fixed guns sliding around on floor
-Improved reloading stability
-Inputs for WMR and HP Reverb (experimental, still not officially supported)
-graphics settings menu
-fixed some ‘goons sliding around’ issues
-fixed issues with some goons not spawning
-added option for volumetric fog

Now that the engine migration is complete, we’ll be able to focus our efforts on more bugfixes and performance improvements. Once those are in a good place, we’ll move on to additional quality of life features and AI improvements.

Level design for part 2 is already underway and it’s looking sweet!

tags.bug: -fixed issues with some goons not spawning

notes.title: Update 5 (0.1.24)
notes.content:
Hey all! Peter here with another regular update. (new info on wobbly screen issue below)

(0.1.24) Changes:
-fixed multiple problems with holster
-fixed shotgun reloading
-fixed problem with weapons vanishing
-added auto-complete for clips that are partially inserted
-fixed “free bullet after pulling slide/bolt” bug
-fixed issue with goons not being damaged by thrown objects
-fixed dropped magazines always giving full ammo
-slight performance improvements
-fixed shotgun infinite ammo glitch

We’ve been working hard at solving the wobbly-screen issue that many of you are having, and after countless failed attempts, we’ve finally found a possible solution. After migrating our (possibly cursed) project file from Unreal 4.27 to Unreal 5, the wobbliness seems to be gone. It may take a few days to get everything working in Unreal 5, but there should be a fix on the way! I’ll make a post once that’s live.

We’re currently setting up a Discord so we can more easily discuss issues/suggestions/etc, and will post an update when it’s open. Until then, feel free to email heartshotgame@gmail.com or post on the community forums with any issues and we’ll get those sorted ASAP. Thanks!

tags.feature: -added auto-complete for clips that are partially inserted

tags.bug: -fixed issue with goons not being damaged by thrown objects
-fixed dropped magazines always giving full ammo

notes.title: Holster Update
notes.content:
(0.1.23)

Hello everyone! I’m very excited to announce that due to popular demand, we’ve added holsters to the game. You can drop your weapons over your left or right shoulder to store them whenever you like.

-stability improvements
-fixed issue with attachments not saving properly
-reduced velocity of objects when force grab is canceled mid-grab
-fixed issue with two-handed grip not releasing with hold-grip mode
-fixed issue with silencers not working after level load
-fixed issue with ammo boxes floating
-added collision to cockpit in first mission
-shrunk ammo belt grab area (to avoid accidentally grabbing ammo)
-increased shotgun damage
-reduced gun recoil

As always, feel free to report any problems you encounter on the community forums or to email heartshotgame@gmail.com and we’ll get to them as soon as possible.

Have fun!
